cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Robert F. Woolworth, Winthrop, Maine, 1958; Anne Woolworth, New York, NY, gift, 1959; Georgina Carter Johnson, New York, NY, gift, before 1986; (Coe Kerr Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1986 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature [notes backing inscription 1]. Reddish purple barn with blue–grey roof centre. Small red barn at right. Mountains in background. Grey sky." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, May 1958." Backing inscription 1 includes preparatory work information. O'Keeffe wrote: "There as a fine old barn at the Lake George farmhouse. . . . I have looked at the barn in summer and have looked at in the winter when the snow was deep" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 44). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A dark red barn with a few broken windows sits on pale yellow earth. Behind the barn are dark red hills and a cloudy sky. A small strip of Lake George is visible on either side of the barn.
